1	import React from 'react';
2	import { chakra, useMultiStyleConfig } from '@chakra-ui/react';
3	import { ZimmDrawer } from 'app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer';
4	
5	const ZIMM_CART_DRAWER_RECIPE = 'ZimmCartDrawer';
6	
7	// SFCC-315 builds the drawer shell only — SFCC-277/272 (later commits in this same 18-commit
8	// plan) will replace this with the real empty-bag component. This placeholder exists only so
9	// the body isn't blank/broken-looking in the meantime.
10	const EMPTY_BAG_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT = 'Your bag is empty.';
11	
12	export type ZimmCartDrawerProps = {
13	  /** Whether the drawer is open. */
14	  isOpen: boolean;
15	  /** Called on backdrop click, Escape, and the close button (all via ZimmDrawer/Chakra's Drawer). */
16	  onClose: () => void;
17	  /** Number of line items in the bag. Drives the header title ("BAG • {itemCount}" vs
18	   *  "YOUR BAG IS EMPTY") and whether `children` or the interim empty-state placeholder renders. */
19	  itemCount: number;
20	  /** Element to focus once the drawer finishes closing — see ZimmDrawer's own doc (AC10
21	   *  focus-return); without this Chakra falls back to focusing document.body. */
22	  finalFocusRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>;
23	  /** Cart line items. This organism owns no item-rendering logic itself — the caller supplies
24	   *  the list (SFCC-270's ProductItem, wired in a later commit in this same plan). Rendered only
25	   *  while itemCount > 0. */
26	  children: React.ReactNode;
27	  /** Reserved slot for SFCC-404's message-aggregation system (validation/error/promo banners).
28	   *  Always rendered, even with nothing passed — see zimmCartDrawer.css.ts's `messages` part:
29	   *  the band reserves height regardless, so the drawer doesn't change position when a message
30	   *  appears or disappears. */
31	  messages?: React.ReactNode;
32	  /** Reserved slot for SFCC-275's button group (checkout / continue shopping). Not built in this
33	   *  commit (SFCC-315 is shell-only) — this organism only provides the slot it will render into
34	   *  later. */
35	  footer?: React.ReactNode;
36	};
37	
38	/**
39	 * SFCC-315 — the Cart drawer shell. Wraps ZimmDrawer (size="xLarge") with the cart-specific
40	 * header title, a height-reserving messages band, a responsive items/totals layout, and a
41	 * footer slot.
42	 *
43	 * Deliberately not wired to a trigger yet — no `_app`/`product-view` changes, no
44	 * `useCartDrawer` hook, no button-group content, no real empty-state body, no message
45	 * aggregation. All of those are separate, later commits in this same 18-commit plan — this
46	 * organism is exercised only via its own Storybook stories today.
47	 *
48	 * Figma-fidelity audit fix, 2026-09-19: `ZimmDrawer`'s `title` was passed with no `titleStyle`,
49	 * so it silently took that prop's default (`'large'` → `heading1`, 24px) instead of the Figma
50	 * spec for this header ("BAG • #", 14px medium — `body2Strong`). Measured live before the fix:
51	 * 24px/400/32px against the 14px/500 spec. `ZimmDrawer` itself already supports both correctly
52	 * (`titleStyle="small"` → `body2Strong`, confirmed against `typography.ts`) — this was a missing
53	 * prop at the call site, not a defect in `ZimmDrawer`.
54	 *
55	 * @param props see ZimmCartDrawerProps
56	 */
57	export const ZimmCartDrawer = ({
58	  isOpen,
59	  onClose,
60	  itemCount,
61	  finalFocusRef,
62	  children,
63	  messages,
64	  footer,
65	}: ZimmCartDrawerProps) => {
66	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_CART_DRAWER_RECIPE, {});
67	  const title = itemCount === 0 ? 'YOUR BAG IS EMPTY' : `BAG • ${itemCount}`;
68	
69	  return (
70	    <ZimmDrawer
71	      isOpen={isOpen}
72	      onClose={onClose}
73	      size="xLarge"
74	      title={title}
75	      titleStyle="small"
76	      finalFocusRef={finalFocusRef}
77	    >
78	      <chakra.div __css={styles.messages}>{messages}</chakra.div>
79	      <chakra.div __css={styles.body}>
80	        {itemCount === 0 ? <chakra.p textStyle="body2">{EMPTY_BAG_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT}</chakra.p> : children}
81	      </chakra.div>
82	      <chakra.div __css={styles.footer}>{footer}</chakra.div>
83	    </ZimmDrawer>
84	  );
85	};

  cart commit will appear to fail it, for a reason that has nothing to do with that commit. Treat
  it as "scoped to this step's own new files" going forward, not as a repo-wide invariant.
- A co-located recipe's Chakra lookup key (e.g. `ZIMM_CART_EMPTY_STATE_RECIPE = 'ZimmCartEmptyState'`
  in `index.tsx`) is typed as an independent string literal in the component file, disconnected
  from the `.css.ts` export name and the `theme/components/index.ts` map key it must match by
  spelling alone — confirmed present in 4/4 siblings checked (`zimmCartItemActions`,
  `zimmCartDrawer`, `zimmBenefits`, `zimmBadge`) by step 4.5's own Tester (2026-09-21). A rename of
  the recipe's export would silently desync the lookup with no thrown error, no failing test. Real,
  UNIFORM, and pre-existing well before this build — not something any one step should fix as a
  side effect of its own work. Worth a follow-up: a shared const or a `satisfies`-checked mapping
  would close it once, everywhere, rather than leaving each new component to repeat the same
  disconnected-string pattern.

Every load-bearing claim in the brief was independently re-measured, not re-read — details below. ## Per-axis verdict (most severe first) | Axis | Verdict | Basis | |---|---|---| | **Pass criteria** | PASS | 3/4/5 met with fresh evidence I gathered myself (below). 1/2 are not met by this diff and can't be — `zimmCartDrawer/index.tsx:80` still renders its own hardcoded `EMPTY_BAG_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT` and never imports `ZimmCartEmptyState` at all (I read the current file myself, not the Tester's grep output). This is the same shape the plan already normalised for step 4.3's criterion — real wiring belongs to step 4.6, which literally owns "Empty basket renders `ZimmCartEmptyState`" as its own pass criterion 5. Not a defect of this diff; see "What Marcel is missing" below for the one loose end this leaves. | | **Design fidelity** | PASS | Live-measured in a real Chromium tab against the actual running Storybook (localhost:6006), not read off source. Results below. | | **Completeness** | PASS | 3 stories (`Default`, `AtNonAuSite`, `SpansBothDrawerColumnsAtDesktop`), `play()` on the two that assert behaviour, recipe test present. No `index.test.tsx` — correctly not required: the component takes zero props and has zero branching (the `isRegistered` drop confirmed this), matching `testing.md`'s own "no branching or decision logic at all" exemption (same shape as `BottomBar`). Two trivial docblock nits, not blocking (see Defects). | | **Conformance** | PASS | `recipeGuards`/`recipeParts` green (57 tests). `audit:tokens` fresh run: 9 pre-existing repo violations, zero in any file this diff touches. Base-path `Link` import is correct, not a violation — confirmed `overrides/app/components/link/` does not exist, so there's nothing "already overridden" to route around. CODEOWNERS routing confirmed by hand: `theme/components/index.ts` → Tier 2, the new `.css.ts` → squads-only Tier 3, matching the Orchestrator's tier read exactly. | | **Correctness** | PASS | `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0. Full `npm run test`: 122 files, 1675 tests, all green (ran fresh, not trusted from an earlier pass). `eslint` on the 5 changed files: clean. Zero console errors, zero page errors, zero axe-core violations on all 3 stories — I ran my own Playwright + injected `axe-core` pass, independent of whatever the Tester used. | | **Restraint** | PASS | Diff is exactly 5 files (`git status`/`git diff --stat`, run by me, matches Orchestrator's IN SCOPE). Tester's 5-sub-angle Full loop matches B4's plan-designated scale (`plan.md` §2) plus the §5.0 mandatory live-story-render check (point 9) — not an over-run. I did not re-run the recipe's mutation test a third time (Tester already ran it twice); I confirmed by reading the assertion directly that it's a non-vacuous `toEqual` on the literal value, so a third run would have been exactly the kind of redundant re-check this build is trying to stop paying for. | ## What I tried to falsify - **"CTA href carries the site prefix."** Didn't trust the story's own internal `expect()` — read the rendered anchor's `href` attribute directly out of the DOM. AU/default site: `/`. UK site: `/en-GB/`. Matches. - **"Spans both drawer columns, no dead space."** Measured `getBoundingClientRect()` on the harness and the component root live: both **930px**, `gridColumn` computed as `1 / -1`. Not a source read of the recipe object — an actual rendered box. - **"Deferred to 4.6, not silently dropped."** Read `zimmCartDrawer/index.tsx` myself, fresh. Line 80 confirms the drawer still renders its own placeholder string and never references `ZimmCartEmptyState`. - **"Zero console/axe errors across all 3 stories."** Independent Playwright session, own `axe-core` injection (not reusing whatever harness the Tester used) — 0 violations, 0 console errors, 0 page errors, all 3 stories. - **"Alias tokens actually reach the rendered pixel."** Per §5.0 point 2 (a wrapper's style doesn't prove the leaf inherits it) — measured the `

` and `` leaf nodes' own computed style, not the `Text`/`Button` wrapper props: text colour `rgb(25,25,25)` and CTA background `rgb(25,25,25)` both trace to `grey[900]` (`colour.ts:8` = `#191919`) through `text.default`/`action.primary.bgDefault` — confirmed by reading the alias tier, not assumed. - **"24px gap, not the raw 25px Figma value."** Measured the live pixel distance between the paragraph's bottom edge and the button's top edge: exactly 24px. - **Diff scope.** Ran `git status --short` again after every verification command, to make sure none of my own tooling (build, lint, audit) had silently touched the tree. Still exactly the 2 original changes. A verification pass that finds nothing hasn't proven it's capable of finding anything — worth saying I did find something: my own `document.querySelector('a')` (unscoped to `#storybook-root`) grabbed a stray Storybook-manager UI link on the first attempt, wrongly reporting a docs-site href. Caught by cross-checking against the scoped `innerHTML` dump before trusting the number — a reminder that even a live measurement can measure the wrong element if it isn't scoped correctly, not just prove the claim right. ## What I could not verify - **The two settled-decision citations (no CTA in Figma, no `isRegistered` anywhere) against the raw `figma-reference/empty-bag.md`/`session-notes.md` source files themselves.** I read `plan.md`'s own "CONFIRMED 2026-09-21" record directly (lines 455–466) — that's Marcel's own settled call, already independently checked against those sources twice (Tester, Orchestrator). Re-opening the primary Figma/session-notes files myself would be a fourth pass at an already-closed decision, which is exactly the re-verification this build is trying to stop paying for. Flagging the boundary rather than hiding it. - **Real nested rendering inside the actual `ZimmCartDrawer` panel.** Only the shape-alike harness exists today (by design — the drawer doesn't accept this component as `children` yet). The 930px/930px match is a faithful stand-in, not the real thing. This is this step's one real residual risk — see below. - **Mobile/tablet rendering.** Not checked live, and correctly not needed: this recipe's only rule is scoped inside a desktop-only `@media` query, and the drawer body is `display:flex` (not grid) below that breakpoint, so `gridColumn` is inert there by construction, not by omission. - **Storybook's own a11y *addon panel*.** The repo has no addon-a11y wired (already logged in `handoff.md`, pre-existing infra gap, not this step's job) — I ran `axe-core` directly instead, which is a stricter, independent check, not a substitute for the same tooling. ## Non-blocking nits (your call, not a REWORK reason) 1. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmCartEmptyState/index.tsx:38,88` — docblock cites the precedent as `` `recentlyViewed/index.tsx` `` with no folder; the real file is `overrides/app/pages/recentlyViewed/index.tsx` (confirmed via `find` — no `overrides/app/components/recentlyViewed/` exists). Substance is correct (I checked the real file: `Box > Center > Stack`, `isRegistered` branch, `paddingY="var(--zimm-scale-4xl)"` all match as described) — only the implied location is off. CONFIRMED, cosmetic only. 2. Decision log item 5 (`index.tsx:148-150`) says text alignment is "inherited from the mandated Box > Center > Stack precedent structure" but doesn't mention the CTA needs its own separate `alignSelf="center"` (`index.tsx:127`) to actually centre — `textAlign` on a flex `Stack` centres text, not a flex child's own box. I live-measured both: text-align resolves `center` on the `.chakra-stack`, and the anchor's own `align-self` resolves `center` too — functionally correct, the log just undersells that it's two separate mechanisms, not one. CONFIRMED, cosmetic only. Neither changes what ships. Fine to fix inline in the same commit (near-zero cost, file's already open) or carry forward — I'm not blocking on either. ## Marcel's visual checkpoint (owed — first rendered-output step since 4.4) Storybook is live at `localhost:6006`. Three URLs, in order of what to look at: 1. `?path=/story/commerce-zimmcartemptystate--default` — a centred block: one line of grey-900 body text ("If you'd like some help, please get in touch with our Client Services team."), a 24px gap, then a solid black, uppercase "CONTINUE SHOPPING" button with white text, centred (auto-width on desktop). **Wrong looks like:** button not black/white/uppercase, text left-aligned instead of centred, or visible extra/missing space above or below the block (there's deliberately no padding here — it inherits the drawer's own, so in isolation it may look tight against the story canvas edges, that's expected). 2. `?path=/story/commerce-zimmcartemptystate--at-non-au-site` — should look pixel-identical to Default. Nothing to eyeball differently; the only difference is the link's destination underneath, not anything visible. 3. `?path=/story/commerce-zimmcartemptystate--spans-both-drawer-columns-at-desktop` — **only means something at a browser width ≥1280px.** Shows the same centred block sitting inside a bordered-looking two-column grid harness, filling it edge-to-edge left-to-right. **Wrong looks like:** the content squeezed into roughly the left third of the box with visible empty space on the right — that's the exact bug this recipe exists to prevent (confined to the 360px items column instead of spanning both tracks). Nothing here shows the component inside the *real* cart drawer — that view doesn't exist yet (step 4.6 wires it in).
